description: This file contains internal utility functions for distributed testing in PyTorch, including RPC setup, failure simulation, and debug info retrieval.

methods.name: dist_init
methods.description: Decorator for setting up and tearing down distributed RPC environment for tests.

methods.name: wait_until_node_failure
methods.description: Loops until an RPC to a specific node fails, indicating node failure.

methods.name: wait_until_pending_futures_and_users_flushed
methods.description: Waits until all pending RRef futures and users are processed.

methods.name: get_num_owners_and_forks
methods.description: Retrieves number of OwnerRRefs and forks from debug info.

methods.name: wait_until_owners_and_forks_on_rank
methods.description: Waits until specified number of owners and forks exist on a given rank.

methods.name: initialize_pg
methods.description: Initializes process group for distributed testing if not already initialized.

methods.name: worker_name
methods.description: Returns the worker name string for a given rank.

methods.name: get_function_event
methods.description: Retrieves a specific profiling event matching a partial name from function events.
